notes.title: Update 1.0.245 - Leaderboards
notes.content:
With more people appearing on the leaderboards, we wanted to make them prettier:


Leaderboards now show players' avatars
Leaderboards are now scrollable (yes, they now contain more than six entries!)
You can now directly access players' profiles from the leaderboards
Many experimental VRAM-related game performance improvements

notes.title: Minor Fix 1.0.145
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where goblins tried to cheat by hiding crossbows in the ground
Fixed a bug when Eva's dialogue box would try to go off-screen

notes.title: Minor Fix 1.0.14
notes.content: Switching dimensions now occurs when you press the corresponding button and not when you release it

notes.title: Update 1.0.135 - Controllers
notes.content:
Complete overhaul of the game's input system
Added support for almost every gamepad that exists and that doesn't
Added more options for key binding
You can now remap your controller buttons
Added full Steam Input API integration (even more devices!)
Eva will no longer guess what device you're using (now SHE KNOWS)

Please note that due to a complete overhaul of the input system, this update resets your in-game keybindings.
Please also note that this update may not be stable and may cause bugs, crashes, or demon invocations.
